questions.prompt: Does copying a raw pointer copy the pointed-to object?
questions.explanation: Only the address value is copied.

questions.prompt: In C++, how many owners can a single std::unique_ptr represent at one time for the object it manages?
questions.explanation: unique_ptr models exclusive ownership: exactly one owner at a time, so the answer is 1. It cannot be copied, only moved.

questions.prompt: Two std::unique_ptr a and b exist; a owns an object and b is empty. After b = std::move(a), how many unique_ptr objects own the object?
questions.explanation: Moving transfers ownership: b now owns the object and a becomes null. Before 1 owner, after 1 owner, so the answer is 1.

questions.prompt: A std::vector has size() == 3. How many of its elements are valid (constructed and accessible)?
questions.explanation: size() is the number of valid elements, so there are 3 (indices 0, 1, 2). Spare capacity beyond size() holds no valid elements.
